post.description:
1. Only the root user can delete members
2. The root user cannot delete itself, otherwise `409 Conflict`
3. Deletion is a soft delete: `status` on the `user` table and on the `group` table (`type=PERSON`) is set to `DISABLED`
4. All sessions of the user in the session table are hard-deleted
5. All cached sessions of the user are removed
6. If the target user is an administrator of a non-personal organization, they must first leave the organization or have their role changed
7. All related projects, collaborators and applications are deleted
8. The user's SSO ProviderUser bindings are deleted

204.description: No Content, deleted successfully (soft delete); empty response body

401.description: Unauthorized, no valid credentials were provided

example.message: no permission to delete the user

404.description: Not_Found the user does not exist

409.description: Conflict the root user cannot be deleted; Conflict the target user is an administrator of an organization (excluding the personal one)

post.description: Creates an organization space and optionally assigns an owner. The organization type is `TEAM`; when `owner` is omitted the organization belongs to the current root user. The owner joins the organization with the `OWNER` role. The organization `username` is globally unique and case-insensitive.

username.description: The organization's `username` (required), 1-25 characters, letters, digits, `-` and `_` only, globally unique and case-insensitive

owner.description: The owner's `username` (optional); defaults to the current root user, and the owner must be enabled

profile.description: Organization profile (optional), same fields as `profile` in `POST /group`

post.description:
Binds the given SwanLab user to a third-party account of an enabled Provider. Fields match `POST /internal/sso/bind`, with `userId` replaced by `username`.

Not idempotent: binding the same `(provider, providerUserId)` again returns `409`; to rebind, call `POST /self_hosted/sso/bind/del` first.

provider.description: Provider name (required); the Provider must be enabled

providerUserId.description: Unique identifier of the third-party user (required)

201.description: Created, bound successfully, no response body

401.description: Unauthorized, no valid credentials were provided

403.description: Forbidden, the caller is not the root user

404.description: Not Found: the user does not exist (unregistered or disabled); the provider does not exist or is not enabled

409.description: Conflict: the third-party account is already bound to another SwanLab user; the user already has a binding under this Provider

servers.description: Self-hosted instance (replace with your instance domain)

post.description:
Deletes the binding between the given user and the given third-party account. The triple `username` + `provider` + `providerUserId` must match exactly; any mismatch (for example, the third-party account is actually bound to another user) returns `404`.

Unlike the bind endpoint: the Provider does not need to be enabled (leftovers under a disabled Provider can still be cleaned up), and `username` is not restricted by user status (bindings of disabled users are kept and must remain removable).

username.description: The SwanLab user's `username` (required), any user status

provider.description: Provider name (required), does not need to be enabled

providerUserId.description: Unique identifier of the third-party user (required)

204.description: No Content, unbound successfully, no response body

401.description: Unauthorized, no valid credentials were provided

403.description: Forbidden, the caller is not the root user

404.description: Not Found: the provider does not exist; the user does not exist; the binding does not exist (including triple mismatch)

example.description: invalid request body or unsupported grant_type

404.description: not_found: the app_id does not exist

500.description: parse_error: failed to parse JSON; random_error: failed to generate token; database_error: Redis operation failed
